Messages.Author: TheLasombra
Messages.Body:
Thucimia bleeds, reduces hand size (discard 2 cards) = Bleed of 2. Plays Cog and untaps.  On her prey's turn she bleeds with the Cog action, reduces hand size again = bleed of 4?

Is that right?

Thucimia has one vote (titled). Once each time she bleeds, she may reduce your hand size by 2 until your next untap phase to get +1 bleed. +1 handsize. Blood cursed.

Messages.Author: Rulemonger
Messages.Body:
> TheLasombra wrote:
> Thucimia bleeds, reduces hand size (discard 2 cards) = Bleed of 2. Plays Cog and untaps.  On her prey's turn she bleeds with the Cog action, reduces hand size again = bleed of 4?
>
> Is that right?
No.

Hand size reduction lasts until your next untap phase. +1 bleed lasts for the current action.

So on the Cog: Base 1 + 1 (Cog) +1 (hand size reduct special) = 3.
